cards.back:
The place or process of entering a country to live or visit.
Bahasa Indonesia: imigrasi
Example: An officer at immigration stamped our passports and welcomed us.
cards.say: immigration. An officer at immigration stamped our passports and welcomed us.

cards.back:
An official stamp that lets you enter or stay in a country.
Bahasa Indonesia: visa
Example: You need a visa before you can travel to some countries.
cards.say: visa. You need a visa before you can travel to some countries.

cards.back:
A place protected because it is important to history or culture.
Bahasa Indonesia: situs warisan
Example: Borobudur is a famous heritage site visited by people from many countries.
cards.say: heritage site. Borobudur is a famous heritage site visited by people from many countries.

cards.back:
A well known building or place that is easy to recognise.
Bahasa Indonesia: tengara, ikon
Example: The tall tower is the best known landmark in the city.
cards.say: landmark. The tall tower is the best known landmark in the city.

cards.back:
A style of cooking that belongs to a country or region.
Bahasa Indonesia: masakan khas
Example: Padang cuisine is famous for its rich, spicy dishes.
cards.say: cuisine. Padang cuisine is famous for its rich, spicy dishes.

cards.back:
Including people from many different cultures.
Bahasa Indonesia: multikultural
Example: Jakarta is a multicultural city where many languages are spoken.
cards.say: multicultural. Jakarta is a multicultural city where many languages are spoken.

cards.back:
To change words from one language into another.
Bahasa Indonesia: menerjemahkan
Example: Can you translate this sign from Dutch into English for me?
cards.say: translate. Can you translate this sign from Dutch into English for me?

cards.back:
Belonging to another country.
Bahasa Indonesia: asing
Example: She loves learning foreign languages such as French and Japanese.
cards.say: foreign. She loves learning foreign languages such as French and Japanese.

cards.back:
Born in a place, or belonging to it by birth.
Bahasa Indonesia: asli, pribumi
Example: The orangutan is native to the forests of Borneo and Sumatra.
cards.say: native. The orangutan is native to the forests of Borneo and Sumatra.

cards.back:
To move from one place to another, often in a season.
Bahasa Indonesia: bermigrasi
Example: Many birds migrate to warmer lands when the cold season begins.
cards.say: migrate. Many birds migrate to warmer lands when the cold season begins.

cards.back:
Unusual and exciting because it comes from far away.
Bahasa Indonesia: eksotis
Example: The market sold exotic fruits that I had never tasted.
cards.say: exotic. The market sold exotic fruits that I had never tasted.

cards.back:
The broken remains of very old buildings.
Bahasa Indonesia: reruntuhan kuno
Example: We walked through the ancient ruins and imagined the busy town.
cards.say: ancient ruins. We walked through the ancient ruins and imagined the busy town.

cards.back:
A traveller who carries a bag and travels cheaply.
Bahasa Indonesia: pelancong ransel
Example: The backpacker slept in simple hostels and walked between villages.
cards.say: backpacker. The backpacker slept in simple hostels and walked between villages.

cards.back:
Sharing ideas and customs between people from different countries.
Bahasa Indonesia: pertukaran budaya
Example: Our school welcomed visitors for a cultural exchange week.
cards.say: cultural exchange. Our school welcomed visitors for a cultural exchange week.

cards.back:
Friendly and generous treatment of guests.
Bahasa Indonesia: keramahan
Example: We were touched by the hospitality of the village family.
cards.say: hospitality. We were touched by the hospitality of the village family.

cards.back:
Tiredness after a long flight across different time zones.
Bahasa Indonesia: jet lag
Example: After the flight from London, jet lag kept him awake at night.
cards.say: jet lag. After the flight from London, jet lag kept him awake at night.

cards.back:
A building at an airport where passengers wait for flights.
Bahasa Indonesia: terminal
Example: Our flight leaves from terminal two, so follow the blue signs.
cards.say: terminal. Our flight leaves from terminal two, so follow the blue signs.

cards.back:
A card that allows you to get on a plane.
Bahasa Indonesia: kartu naik pesawat
Example: Show your boarding pass to the officer at the gate.
cards.say: boarding pass. Show your boarding pass to the officer at the gate.

cards.back:
A region of the world that uses the same clock time.
Bahasa Indonesia: zona waktu
Example: Jakarta and London are in different time zones.
cards.say: time zone. Jakarta and London are in different time zones.

cards.back:
A person who leads travellers through a wild area.
Bahasa Indonesia: pemandu ekspedisi
Example: The expedition guide checked that everyone had enough water.
cards.say: expedition guide. The expedition guide checked that everyone had enough water.

cards.back:
A journey to a holy place.
Bahasa Indonesia: ziarah
Example: Many families make a pilgrimage to the old mosque each year.
cards.say: pilgrimage. Many families make a pilgrimage to the old mosque each year.

cards.back:
Of the hot, wet regions near the equator.
Bahasa Indonesia: tropis
Example: Tropical forests are home to thousands of unusual plants.
cards.say: tropical. Tropical forests are home to thousands of unusual plants.

cards.back:
A new plan for where you will go on a trip.
Bahasa Indonesia: perubahan rencana perjalanan
Example: An itinerary change meant we visited the museum a day earlier.
cards.say: itinerary change. An itinerary change meant we visited the museum a day earlier.
